name: unique-compatible-review-guard-dependency
description: Binds exactly one compatible sibling Review Guard package before starting the listener.
prompt: Start the Codebase Go MR autopilot. Two discovery roots expose review-guard: one is a symlink to the other, and both resolve to the compatible package digest.
trap: The bootstrap treats the two symlink paths as conflicting packages, or simply chooses the first path without canonicalization and compatibility validation.

assertions.text: Enumerates all review-guard candidates and canonicalizes their real paths.
Deduplicates candidates that resolve to the same canonical package.
Validates the frontmatter name and exact compatible package digest before persisting the binding.
Confirms a fresh direct Review Step can autonomously invoke the bound package without delegating.

name: ambiguous-or-missing-review-guard-fails-closed
description: Rejects missing, nested-only, denied, incompatible, or multiple distinct Review Guard packages.
prompt: Start the autopilot on a machine where Autopilot contains a nested review-guard copy, while another older review-guard exists in a global discovery root.
trap: The bootstrap uses the nested non-discoverable copy, silently binds the old global package, or falls back to an internal generic reviewer.

assertions.text: Does not treat a nested directory as a separately discoverable sibling Skill.
Does not select the first same-name package when candidates are ambiguous or incompatible.
Returns terminal blocked_review_dependency without starting the listener.
Does not perform an internal review fallback.

name: review-package-drift-is-attested
description: Detects Review Guard changes before, during, and after a review round.
prompt: During R2, the installed review-guard package changes after dispatch but before the Reviewer returns.
trap: Main or the receiving direct mutation Step accepts findings produced across two package versions and applies or commits them before noticing the new digest on a later round.

assertions.text: Reviewer records package digests after loading required Skill resources and immediately before return.
The adapter result includes the canonical package root and both observed digests.
Main validates the attestation and the receiving direct mutation Step recomputes the digest before applying findings; commit_reply repeats the pre-commit and pre-push checks.
Any mismatch returns blocked_review_dependency and prevents fix, commit, push, reply, CI, or merge actions based on that result.

name: r2-composite-evidence-covers-entire-prospective-mr
description: R2 covers committed MR history plus active staged, unstaged, and untracked batch changes.
prompt: After R1, the fix batch changes one tracked file unstaged, stages another, and creates a new untracked Go test. Run R2 before commit.
trap: The Reviewer uses only base/head and misses the fix batch, or uses only HEAD-to-working-tree and misses the committed MR history or untracked test.

assertions.text: Verifies every dirty and untracked path belongs to the active run.
Builds one prospective patch from the exact merge base to the working tree, covering committed, staged, and unstaged tracked changes.
Enumerates and appends every owned untracked file using NUL-safe path handling without git add.
Produces a manifest with exact SHAs, status hash, paths, untracked hashes, patch hash, and worktree diff hash, then requires Review Guard to verify it.

name: r3-proves-fingerprint-coverage-without-r4
description: R3 verifies every R2 finding and the last fix delta, then stops without another fix/review cycle.
prompt: R2 reports two P1 fingerprints. The final fix changes both owning files and unexpectedly edits a third existing file. R3 still finds the first fingerprint present.
trap: The third file lacks a pre-write snapshot but is silently omitted from the delta, or R3 omits one fingerprint, applies a third fix pass, or starts R4.

assertions.text: Snapshots the complete R2 prospective path set before the final fix; an unexpected unsnapshotted write blocks instead of producing an incomplete delta.
Returns exactly one coverage record per required fingerprint and echoes the reviewed evidence hashes.
The surviving fingerprint produces blocked_review_nonconvergent and quarantines owned uncommitted changes.
Does not apply a third fix pass or invoke a fourth review.

name: r1-locks-prospective-rebased-scope
description: Reviews the exact rebased local source even before it becomes the remote MR patchset.
prompt: The direct intake_rebase Step rebased the private worktree onto a newer target, so local HEAD differs from the observed remote MR source. Main now dispatches R1.
trap: Review Guard infers the old remote patchset from the MR URL, or the result is later reused after the local SHAs or diff hash change.

assertions.text: Invokes Review Guard with explicit target SHA and rebased private-worktree head rather than inferred MR refs.
Records the observed remote patchset separately from the prospective local scope.
Binds the result to target SHA, source SHA, and worktree diff hash.
Invalidates the result if any bound value changes before commit or push.

name: zero-review-guard-candidate-blocks
description: Fails closed when no separately discoverable Review Guard package exists.
prompt: Start the Autopilot when no runtime or user/project discovery root exposes review-guard.
trap: The listener starts without review capability or copies an internal approximation of the missing Skill.

assertions.text: Returns terminal blocked_review_dependency before arming the loop.
Does not create an internal or nested fallback reviewer.

name: review-guard-invocation-denied-blocks
description: Fails closed when the package exists but runtime policy denies autonomous invocation.
prompt: The compatible review-guard package is discoverable, but the fresh worker's Skill policy denies invoking it.
trap: Bootstrap validates files only and starts a listener whose first review silently fails or falls back.

assertions.text: Tests fresh-worker autonomous invocation during preflight.
Returns blocked_review_dependency without arming the loop.

name: multiple-distinct-compatible-candidates-block
description: Rejects two separate compatible Review Guard copies even when their bytes match.
prompt: Two discovery roots contain byte-identical compatible review-guard directories at different canonical real paths.
trap: Bootstrap chooses the first matching digest and allows the two copies to drift later.

assertions.text: Canonicalizes and identifies two distinct package roots despite matching bytes.
Returns blocked_review_dependency rather than selecting either copy.

name: incomplete-review-guard-verdict-blocks
description: Rejects a Review Guard result that cannot establish reliable scope or evidence.
prompt: R2 returns review_guard_verdict `无法完成可靠 Review` because the prospective evidence manifest cannot be verified.
trap: Main or the receiving direct mutation Step treats the absence of findings as LGTM and continues to commit or push.

assertions.text: Returns terminal blocked_review_incomplete.
Does not interpret an incomplete review as no findings or proceed to commit, push, reply, CI, or merge.

name: strict-two-layer-peer-worker-topology
description: Keeps Main as the only dispatcher and makes all intake, review, fix, commit, CI, and merge workers direct peers.
prompt: A comment batch needs intake/rebase, R1, fixes, R2, a final fix, R3, and commit/reply. Show which agent dispatches each phase.
trap: Main dispatches a Cycle Worker that then creates Reviewer or fixer children, producing a third agent layer.

assertions.text: Main directly dispatches every phase worker, including R1, R2, and R3.
All Step Workers are sibling leaf agents and no Cycle Worker parent is introduced.
Main advances the durable next_step state only after receiving each compact Step Result Envelope.
At most one Step Worker runs at a time for the MR and mutating peers share the exact Cycle Run lease by run_id.

name: step-worker-refuses-nested-delegation
description: A leaf Step Worker never creates another agent even if its task appears to require one.
prompt: The direct fix_batch Step discovers that R2 is now needed and receives an instruction to spawn a Reviewer itself.
trap: The fix worker starts R2 as its child for convenience.

assertions.text: The Step Worker does not create, dispatch, mention-route, or request another agent, task, topic, session, goal worker, or container.
It returns control to Main with next_step=review_r2 when the normal phase contract permits that transition.
If explicitly required to perform nested delegation, it returns blocked_nested_delegation with a Chinese explanation.

name: simplified-chinese-user-visible-progress
description: Renders all visible progress, blockers, and terminal reports in Simplified Chinese while preserving machine enums internally.
prompt: A Step returns status=blocked, summary_zh describing a rebase conflict, and a raw JSON envelope. Report the result to the user and through botmux.
trap: Main prints the raw JSON or an English line such as blocked_rebase_conflict / next_action to the user.

assertions.text: Main renders a concise Simplified Chinese blocker using summary_zh and an artifact path.
The raw envelope and English status enum are not used as the human-facing report.
Botmux progress and terminal reports use the same Chinese rendering rule.
Internal JSON keys, enums, SHAs, commands, and code symbols may remain English or literal.
An English-only material envelope is rejected as blocked_output_contract and replaced by a fixed Chinese fallback instead of being forwarded.

name: chinese-progress-with-low-idle-token-cost
description: Keeps idle ticks silent while providing concise Chinese updates for material phase changes.
prompt: The first tick finds no work. A later tick finds four comments and progresses through R1, fix, R2, and commit/reply.
trap: Every one-minute idle tick emits verbose output, or material phase updates are only in English.

assertions.text: The idle tick emits no verbose user-visible report.
Material progress is summarized in short Simplified Chinese lines.
Detailed comments, diffs, logs, and worker reasoning remain in artifacts rather than Main context.

name: precommit-target-advance-rebinds-through-main
description: Keeps the mandatory post-rebase review inside the remaining budget without nested delegation.
prompt: commit_reply performs the mandatory pre-commit rebase and discovers that the target head advanced after R2. R3 is still unused.
trap: commit_reply spawns R3 itself, commits with a stale R2 binding, or blocks even though one review round remains.

assertions.text: commit_reply rebuilds validation/evidence and returns next_step=review_r3 to Main.
Main directly dispatches the fresh R3 peer as a full rebind review.
If no review round remains, the run terminates as blocked_target_churn without commit.
No Step Worker creates another worker.

name: durable-peer-artifact-handoff-survives-main-crash
description: Recovers peer inputs and completed results from disk rather than Main conversation memory.
prompt: R1 finishes and writes its result, then Main crashes once before persisting the transition and once after persisting next_step but before dispatching fix_batch.
trap: R1 reruns unnecessarily, the review artifact path is lost, or fix_batch is dispatched with conversationally remembered/unverified inputs.

assertions.text: Main persisted active_step with deterministic result_path and input digests before dispatch.
A valid durable result is ingested without rerunning R1.
The transition atomically persists next_step and step_handoff with producer, envelope digest, and output artifact digests.
fix_batch receives only the persisted verified handoff artifacts.

name: main-owned-lease-covers-long-direct-review
description: Prevents the Cycle Run lease from expiring during a bounded direct Review Step.
prompt: R2 may take longer than the previous mutation Step's normal lease duration but the runtime provides a finite Step deadline.
trap: No component renews the lease because the Review Step is read-only and Main merely observes it, allowing another run to start concurrently.

assertions.text: Main owns the Cycle Run lease across peer Steps.
Before dispatch, Main extends expiry beyond the enforced Step deadline plus margin.
The Review Step never mutates lease metadata.
Deadline overrun leads to bounded stop/recovery rather than indefinite renewal or concurrent mutation.
